metadata.title: Meta stock in focus after unveiling $299 AI smart glasses to expand wearables push

content.text:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus.
Meta Platforms (NASDAQ:META) stock is in focus on Wednesday, as it introduced a new line of AI-powered smart glasses starting at $299, widening its wearable push with a cheaper option than last year's $800 Ray-Ban Display model.
Meta said the devices will be built with EssilorLuxottica and sold under its own brand, rather than through names such as Ray-Ban or Oakley. The lineup includes 26 styles across different frame shapes, colors and lens choices, including prescription lenses.
Meta also said one version will be created in collaboration with media personality Kylie Jenner. The company said the glasses use its newest AI technology and are designed to make virtual assistance more widely available to everyday users.
The launch gives Meta another step in its effort to push AI features into consumer hardware. It also adds a lower-priced option to a product category that the company has been expanding through partnerships and branded eyewear.
